dynamicVars.dynamicVar: SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, CustomerName, City, Region, CustomerType FROM Customers WHERE IsActive = TRUE ORDER BY CustomerID
SELECT DISTINCT OrderID, OrderDetailID FROM OrderDetails ORDER BY OrderID
SELECT distinct OrderID FROM Orders WHERE OrderStatus = 'Pending'
SELECT distinct OrderID, OrderNumber, OrderDate FROM Orders

queryDefs.queryDef: SELECT c.CustomerID as CustomerID, c.CustomerName as CustomerName, c.City as City, c.Region as Region, c.CustomerType as CustomerType FROM Customers c WHERE c.Region IN (${regionList}) ORDER BY c.CustomerID

queries.sheet: SELECT o.OrderID as OrderID, o.OrderNumber as OrderNumber, o.OrderStatus as OrderStatus, od.OrderDetailID as DetailID, o.TotalAmount FROM Orders o INNER JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE o.OrderID IN (${orderDetails.OrderID}) AND o.OrderID IN (${activeOrders.OrderID}) ORDER BY o.OrderID DESC

SELECT o.OrderNumber as OrderNumber, o.OrderDate as OrderDate, o.OrderStatus as OrderStatus, c.CustomerName as CustomerName, o.TotalAmount FROM Orders o INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE o.OrderID IN (${recentOrders.OrderID}) AND o.OrderStatus IN (${statusList}) ORDER BY o.OrderDate DESC

SELECT c.CustomerName as CustomerName, c.Region as Region, COUNT(o.OrderID) as OrderCount, SUM(o.TotalAmount) as TotalOrderAmount FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE c.CustomerID IN (${customerData.CustomerID}) AND c.Region IN (${customerData.Region}) AND o.OrderID IN (${activeOrders.OrderID}) AND o.OrderDate >= '${startDate}'::date AND o.OrderDate <= '${endDate}'::date GROUP BY c.CustomerName, c.Region ORDER BY TotalOrderAmount DESC

SELECT 'Current Time' as Category, '${CURRENT_TIMESTAMP}' as CurrentTime, '${CURRENT_DATE}' as CurrentDate, '${CURRENT_TIME}' as CurrentTimeOnly, '${UNIX_TIMESTAMP}' as UnixTimestamp, '${GETDATE}' as SQLServer_GETDATE UNION ALL SELECT 'Dynamic Variable Test' as Category, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CurrentTime, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as CurrentDate, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'HH24:MI:SS') as CurrentTimeOnly, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::int as UnixTimestamp, NOW() as SQLServer_GETDATE
